stories.headline: The 'advisor paradox' of clients who trust AI for financial advice
stories.body: Adults who have financial advisors are three times as likely to act on AI's money advice without checking, new research shows. Those results, which defy conventional wisdom, will outlast the company that uncovered them.

stories.headline: 10-year Treasury yield slides as traders mull over Democrats' midterm victories, oil prices drop
stories.body: Treasury yields were last little changed Wednesday as investors weighed big wins from Democrats in the U.S. midterm elections.
